# Claims

Every number said on stage or posted, with the study that produces it and its
status. A claim is on screen only when its status is **verified**; a **pilot**
value comes from the 1,600-surface rough-Bergomi pilot and is not quoted as a
result. The table is generated by `studies/claims.py` from the files in
`results/calibration`; nothing in it is typed by hand.
